- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Migrate TrainingConfig and ValidationConfig together, making `cfg.train` and `cfg.validation` authoritative in the shared training loop while preserving existing CLI behavior.

- Read training/evaluation batch sizes, horizons, stopping policies, validation controls, and runtime housekeeping from the run config. Resolve batch-size defaults centrally before constructing training services.
- Keep derived training/evaluation iteration counts on the config; leave runtime progress on its existing owner.
- Update scheduler, dataloader, checkpoint-resume, RL batching, warmup, and dataset-construction consumers. Keep `test_mode` only in TransformerConfig while retaining `--test-mode`.
- Keep inference independent of TrainingConfig: correct pure inference/export startup calls and select compatibility-bootstrap services by container type. Checkpoint conversion can still restore sample metadata without creating a training config.

This targets `main` and does not depend on the distributed-config migration (#7778). No copyright-year changes, unrelated formatting cleanup, or new config-specific test file.

## Issue tracking

Related to #3554 (training-loop consolidation).

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py`
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the formatting and lint checks on my PR

No kernel implementation changes. Scoped changed-test Black/isort and undefined-name checks on changed training code pass. All-files pre-commit reports existing failures in untouched files; those changes are not included.

### Validation

Tested implementation: `bfcc1f5a57fc34b3fa55d523b3a16e8a5d299af6`.

- Two-H100 focused suite: **693 passed per rank**, versus **683 passed per rank** on frozen main `cab97ebd1f2005d7d5aa0dfe48e5f877f1e37f53`. One unchanged four-GPU CP-length test was deselected on both sides.
- GPU kernel-warmup behavioral tests: **16 passed per rank**.
- Real two-GPU GPT fresh training, checkpoint resume, and token-threshold batch-size scheduling passed on both revisions. Logged losses, learning rates, batch/sample counts, gradient norms, and evaluation metrics match exactly; timing is excluded.

The focused suite covers runtime-service ordering, native batch defaults, sample-based horizons, evaluation batching/full validation, dataloaders/cache preparation, checkpoint loading/conversion, and RL batching. Checkpoint tests used the same existing CPU-RNG fixture correction from #7778 on both revisions; that unrelated correction is not included here. The full unit suite and full model matrix were not run.

### Code review

Independent full-diff review completed and findings addressed. This PR remains a draft.
